title: Weekly English Review
summary: This week's news highlights significant developments across various sectors, including retail, travel, pharmaceuticals, food safety, monetary policy, and technology. Best Buy's incoming CEO aims to enhance customer experience through smaller store formats, while rising fuel prices are driving up flight costs, posing challenges for travelers. Merck has raised its revenue outlook due to new drug sales but reduced profit guidance due to acquisition costs. Chipotle faces stock declines linked to a potential salmonella outbreak, prompting proactive measures to ensure food safety. Meanwhile, Meta is under scrutiny from Indian regulators, risking its legal protections amid demands for greater accountability.
